mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.25 percentage points within one month signals imminent monetary easing, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day return following a FEDFUNDS decline > 0.25pp is negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real assets financial savings (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and asset accumulation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS shows negative Rank IC over 3 consecutive 12-month rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing output, signaling strong economic activity that supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is not correlated with positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of 12-month rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts exceeding 0.5% signals strong consumer confidence and construction activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by negative 5-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate indicates monetary easing amid economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly acceleration in the CPI index exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals inflationary pressure, prompting central bank policy tightening and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases following CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month.
